sources.title: Liberia Revenue Code, As Amended (2020 consolidation)
sources.coverage: Goods tax rate (Section 1000); services tax rate (Section 1021); excise tax framework/structure (Section 1108-1114, rate schedule 'Schedule I' not embedded in this text extraction)
sources.notes: Downloaded directly from the official LRA portal (revenue.lra.gov.lr), text-based PDF (250 pages, not scanned). Represents the 2020 consolidation; later amendments exist (see LBR-LRA-AMENDMENT-DEC2024, LBR-LRA-AMENDMENT-DEC2025) but were not text-extractable (scanned/image PDFs, no OCR tooling available in this environment).

sources.title: Tax Amendment Act of December 2024, Amending the Liberia Consolidated Revenue Code
sources.institution: Liberia Revenue Authority (LRA) / Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Monrovia)
sources.coverage: Unknown — scanned/image PDF, text not extractable without OCR
sources.notes: A secondary source (vatcalc.com) claims the goods/services tax rate increased from 10% to 12% effective April 2025, ahead of a planned transition to a 15% VAT system in January 2027. This PDF is the most likely primary text for that change but is image-based (pdftotext extracts only 15 bytes); OCR tooling (tesseract) is not available in this collection environment. NOT used to verify any rate — see LBR-LRA-REVENUE-CODE-2020 for the last text-verifiable rate (10%).
